Built-in extraction for RAR, ZIP, 7z, TAR, ISO and more.
Drop files or folders to create RAR5, ZIP or 7z.
密码通过标准输入传递，不写入命令参数或设置。加密任务期间日志在结束后显示。新建仅: Passwords use standard input, never command arguments or settings. Encrypted task logs appear after completion. Creates new RAR5 archives without overwriting existing archives.
已内置 7-Zip，浏览、解压和测试无需安装。RAR 创建与恢复数据仍需单独配置: 7-Zip is included for browsing, extraction and testing. RAR creation and recovery require a separately licensed RARLAB tool.

存在重复路径，无法可靠选择条目。: Duplicate paths prevent reliable item selection.
压缩包包含不安全路径或链接。此原型拒绝解压，请使用受信任的独立工具检查。: This archive contains unsafe paths or links. Extraction was refused; inspect it with a trusted tool.
为原压缩包添加 3% 恢复记录？: Add a 3% recovery record to the original archive?
在压缩包旁创建 10% 恢复卷？: Create 10% recovery volumes beside the archive?
恢复记录会修改原 RAR；恢复卷需要分卷 RAR。请保留备份。: Recovery records modify the original RAR. Recovery volumes require a multi-volume RAR. Keep a backup.
目标目录中已有同名前缀的分卷，请换一个文件名。: Volumes with this name already exist. Choose another name.
已取消；可能留下不完整输出，请检查目标目录。: Cancelled. Partial output may remain; check the destination.
CLI 退出码 {0}。请查看 stderr/stdout。密码错误时可输入密码: Engine exit code {0}. Check stderr/stdout. If the password is wrong, enter it and reload.
密码不能含换行、NUL，且不能超过 127 个 Unicode 码点。: Passwords cannot contain newlines or NUL and must not exceed 127 Unicode code points.
此条目名称含 CLI 模式字符或不安全路径，无法可靠地按选中项解压。: This item contains wildcard characters or an unsafe path and cannot be safely extracted by selection.
请选择文件；分卷范围 0–1000000 MB，恢复记录范围 0–100%。: Select files; volume size must be 0–1000000 MB and recovery record 0–100%.
请选择尚不存在的 .rar 文件名。: Choose a new .rar filename that does not already exist.
源名称含不支持的换行或通配符。: Source names contain unsupported newlines or wildcards.
此原型要求源文件位于同一文件夹；可直接选择它们的共同父文件夹。: Source items must share one parent folder. You may select their common parent folder instead.
输出压缩包不能保存在选中的源文件夹内。: The output archive cannot be inside a selected source folder.

下载页面请选择 macOS ARM（Apple Silicon）或 x64（In: Choose macOS ARM (Apple Silicon) or x64 (Intel) on the download page. Unpack it, then select the rar executable above.
RAR 创建与恢复数据需要单独安装 RARLAB 工具。可打开官网下载，解包后在: RAR creation and recovery require the RARLAB tool. Download it from the official website, unpack it, and select rar in Settings.
语言包只能包含文字；缺失条目会回退到英语。系统文件对话框与 CLI 原始日志可能: Language packs contain text only; missing entries fall back to English. System dialogs and raw CLI logs may use the system or tool language.
已清除历史记录，原文件未删除。: History cleared. Original files were not deleted.
暂不支持打开压缩包内的压缩包。: Opening nested archives is not supported yet.
无法安全打开此文件。: This file cannot be opened safely.
此类型不能直接打开，请先解压后自行检查。: This type cannot be opened directly. Extract it first and inspect it yourself.
仅支持打开不含链接的安全归档中的普通文件，单文件上限 512 MB。: Only regular files in safe, link-free archives can be opened, up to 512 MB per file.
将交给系统默认应用打开。只打开可信文件；编辑不会写回压缩包，退出本软件时临时副本: The system default app will open this copy. Open only trusted files. Edits are not saved back to the archive; temporary copies are removed when ArchiveDesk quits.
没有可打开此文件的默认应用。: No default app could open this file.
已打开临时副本，不会写回压缩包。: Opened a temporary copy. Changes will not be saved to the archive.
压缩包已生成，但后续测试未完成或失败，请检查日志。: The archive was created, but its test failed or was cancelled. Check the log.
已保存配置（不含密码、源路径、分卷大小和恢复比例）。: Profile saved (without passwords, source paths, volume size or recovery ratio).
密码仅在内存中使用；只创建新包，不覆盖旧包、不删除源文件。: Passwords stay in memory. Creates new archives only; never replaces archives or deletes source files.
Examples: *.tmp or *.DS_Store. Supports * and ?. No absolute paths, .. or @ list files.
固实压缩可提高相似文件压缩率，但单文件提取可能更慢。分卷输出放入独立新文件夹。: Solid mode can improve compression of similar files, but single-file extraction may be slower. Volumes use a new separate folder.
ZIP 使用 AES-256，但不能加密文件名，部分系统解压工具不支持此加密。R: ZIP uses AES-256 but cannot encrypt filenames; some system extractors do not support it. RAR5 / 7z support filename encryption.
macOS 的 ctime 是状态变更时间，不等同于创建时间，因此不提供 Win: On macOS, ctime means status-change time, not creation time. The Windows creation-time switch is omitted. ZIP / 7z use engine defaults.
压缩选项无效；排除规则每行一条，不得使用绝对路径、.. 或 @ 列表文件。: Invalid options. Use one exclude pattern per line, without absolute paths, .. or @ list files.
请选择尚不存在且后缀与格式一致的压缩包文件名。: Choose a new filename with the correct extension for the selected format.
信息来自当前目录列表；并非完整的格式属性检测。: Based on the loaded listing, not a complete format-property inspection.
